lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A cluster of approximately 10-15 diffused high-luminance pixels is visible posterior to the gill slits, primarily concentrated in the upper-right quadrant of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal linear boundary is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a transition from higher luminance above to a shadowed region below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes attached to the ventral-lateral region, characteristic of commensal fish (remoras).
